summary: Experienced HR Manager with 10 years of comprehensive HR experience across employee relations, benefits, payroll, compliance, and safety.

experience.title: HR Director
responsibilities: Led onboarding, hiring, and recruiting initiatives, including advertising, staffing agency coordination, applicant administration, interviews, and pre-employment testing.
Managed benefits administration for health, dental, vision, life, disability, and employee assistance programs, including enrollment, changes, terminations, COBRA, and 5500 filings.
Administered 401(k) plan, overseeing eligibility, enrollment meetings, deferral calculations, loans, distributions, and compliance documentation.
Handled payroll processing, compliance with payroll law, garnishments, levies, child support orders, and timekeeping system updates.
Coordinated temporary staffing, including placement, documentation, drug testing, background checks, safety training, and system setup.
Managed training systems: entered new hires, set up training courses and sessions, tracked completions, and maintained training records.
Conducted annual performance reviews, provided managerial support, and managed disciplinary actions and terminations.
Administered unemployment claims, gathered evidence, and coordinated hearings with WorkOne and administrative law judges.
Oversaw workers compensation claims, served as first responder, coordinated with safety director, and maintained OSHA reporting.
Led FAA/DOT drug screening program, administered training, tracked random screens, and coordinated audits.
Implemented EEOC and AAP compliance, managed postings, filings, tracking, and annual reporting.
